summary: Iteration 36: Phase 1 Production Security Hardening - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: Super Admin Control Center, SaaS Management (6 tabs), and Tenant Admin dashboard all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT tokens now include 'role' and 'tenant_id' in payload - verified via base64 decode
Super admin login returns role='super_admin' from DB, not email-based bypass
Tenant admin correctly gets 403 when accessing super admin endpoints (/api/saas/tenants, /api/tenant-users, /api/admin/stats, /api/trial/config)
X-Request-ID header present in all API responses with valid UUID format
Bootstrap at startup confirms super admin role is set in DB
permissions.py is_super_admin() and is_any_admin() are role-based only - no SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS check
TenantScopedRepository base class created in /app/backend/repositories/base.py with mandatory tenant scoping
Compound indexes added for tenant-scoped collections in database.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 verified Phase 1 Production Security Hardening: 1) JWT tokens contain role and tenant_id in payload, 2) Super admin auth is role-based only (no email bypass), 3) permissions.py is_super_admin() checks role=='super_admin' only, 4) X-Request-ID middleware adds unique UUID to all responses, 5) Bootstrap at startup ensures SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS users have role='super_admin' in DB, 6) Tenant admin correctly denied access to super admin endpoints (403), 7) TenantScopedRepository base class enforces tenant_id on all queries, 8) Compound indexes added for tenant-scoped collections. Frontend: Super Admin Control Center shows platform stats, SaaS Management has 6 tabs (Tenants, Admins, Subs, Trials, Plans, Isolation), Tenant Admin dashboard shows only their tenant data.
